children: In connection with Valuno Group AB (publ) today publishing its year-end report, the company's CEO Peter Liljeroos and Chairman Jörgen Eriksson are each publishing a video on Valuno's YouTube channel, with their respective comments on the report.
The videos are available on Valuno's YouTube channel: https://www.youtube.com/@Valuno
Peter Liljeroos, CEO, Valuno Group AB (publ)

Valuno Group AB (publ) is a Stockholm-based company listed on NGM Nordic SME, developing infrastructure for modern cross-border payments. Its Atlas platform connects bank money, stablecoins and blockchain settlement through an intelligent orchestration layer – enabling businesses to move money across borders faster, more transparently and cost-effectively. Valuno was founded 2016 and has been listed since 2019. For more information
